title: The Telo MT1 is a big truck trapped in a tiny truck’s body
summary: The Telo MT1 is America's smallest electric truck, featuring a distinctive Japanese-inspired kei-truck design with a cab-over layout that makes it highly visible on roads. Despite its compact exterior, it offers surprising interior spaciousness, positioning it as a unique alternative in the EV truck market dominated by larger vehicles.
content:
I'm bouncing down the road in San Carlos, California, zipping past behemoth tech companies like EA and Oracle, in America's smallest electric truck.
The Telo MT1 (which stands for "mini truck") unquestionably turns heads because it looks so remarkably different from everything else on the market right now. 
It has a nearly cab-over design, meaning that front-seat passengers sit almost directly over the front axle. It looks a lot like a Japanese kei truck, with a super-short nose and four doors. People stop to stare as we sit at stoplights or roll silently past.

title: The director of Fjord takes the ‘risky position’ of moderator
summary: In "Fjord," director Cristian Mungiu explores a religious Romanian family transplanted to rural Norway, examining tensions between devout faith and secular society. The film addresses themes of cultural displacement and differing values in an increasingly secular Europe.
content:
Renata Reinsve (top center) and Sebastian Stan (top right) play religious Romanians living in Norway. | FLC Press	

Cristian Mungiu's sixth feature, Fjord, concerns a family on trial. They seem like good people, God-fearing. They've just moved from Romania to a small hamlet nestled in the fjords of rural Norway. There is Mamma (Renate Reinsve), Tata (a bald and bespectacled Sebastian Stan), and their passel of children. They are an openly religious and proselytizing family. The parents, unfashionably, believe in punitive  consequences to actions. They would never be accused of gentle parenting. All ought to be well, only Norway in 2026 is extravagantly suspicious of the devout - their famous tolerance reserved for the secular.

zh.title: 《峡湾》导演采取"冒险"调停立场
zh.summary: 在《峡湾》中，导演克里斯蒂安·蒙日乌探索了一个移居挪威乡村的虔诚罗马尼亚家庭，审视虔诚信仰与世俗社会之间的紧张关系。该电影涉及文化流离失所和日益世俗化的欧洲中不同价值观的主题。

title: My brief romance with an AI bird feeder
summary: The $269 Kiwibit Bird Feeder 2 Pro uses AI to identify visiting birds in real-time, initially delighting the user with hundreds of species sightings. However, the experience ultimately proved disappointing, highlighting the gap between AI promise and practical long-term utility.
content:
I miss my sweet tits.	

It started off promising enough. Dozens of tiny, colorful birds were drawn to my garden just a few weeks after I mounted a $350 $269 Kiwibit Bird Feeder 2 Pro. "Looks like Great Tit!" read the first AI-driven alert sent to my phone. "Looks like Eurasian Blue Tit!" read another. I chuckled, still waiting for adulthood to kick in.
This went on for days. Hundreds of miniature tits came to snack on expensive sunflower seeds already husked. They'd skulk about in nearby trees before flittering in to grab a single seed to be safely enjoyed in the canopy above.

title: Elon Musk intensifies attack on Ambani over Starlink India launch delay
summary: Elon Musk has accused Indian billionaire Mukesh Ambani of blocking Starlink's competition in India, citing interference as the cause of the satellite internet service's delayed launch. This escalates tensions between the tech entrepreneur and India's business establishment over market access.
content: Elon Musk has accused Indian billionaire Mukesh Ambani of blocking competition.

zh.summary: 埃隆·马斯克指控印度富豪穆克什·安巴尼阻挠Starlink在印度的竞争，声称其干涉导致该卫星互联网服务上线延迟。这加剧了这位科技企业家与印度商业精英之间围绕市场准入的紧张关系。

title: Anthropic can’t reliably control its AI agents. It’s cutting off its internal evals from the live internet instead
summary: Anthropic has disabled live internet access for all internal AI evaluations, citing inability to reliably control its AI agents in unrestricted environments. The move signals safety concerns as AI capabilities advance beyond predictable parameters.
content: Anthropic said it "turned off live internet access" for "all our internal evaluations" until further notice.

zh.summary: Anthropic因无法在不受限制的环境中可靠控制其AI代理，已禁用所有内部AI评估的实时互联网访问。这一举措表明随着AI能力超越可预测参数，存在安全隐忧。
